s: the sprawling market of herbs, folk magic and witchcraft supplies
w: A sprawling, raw market given over to belief as much as commerce -- stalls overflow with herbs, candles, saint statues, love potions and limpia-ritual supplies. Not primarily a food market, but one of the city's most atmospheric, deeply local corners: a living expression of Mexican folk spirituality most visitors never see.
_facts: Located in the Merced Balbuena neighbourhood, east of the historic centre
Known nationwide for herbal remedies, folk-magic and Santeria/witchcraft supplies
Also sells live animals, piñatas and party goods alongside the esoteric stalls
One of Mexico City's oldest specialty markets
